description.value: Houston Motor Inn is a family-run motel established in 1993, sitting directly on Yellowhead Highway 16 in Houston, BC — a primary east-west corridor for cycle tourists crossing central British Columbia. The property includes an on-site restaurant, free parking, an RV area, and public laundry, giving it practical value beyond a simple meal stop. Pet-friendly and offering complimentary Wi-Fi, it caters to solo and group travellers seeking an affordable and functional base.
